# foreman_defaulttemplate (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_defaulttemplate" "kickstart_default" {
  name = "Kickstart default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the defaulttemplate to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `provisioning_template_id` (Number) ID of provisioning template
- `template_kind_id` (Number)
